GitHub - Davis-Klavins/osm-latvia-bot: Collection of scripts to update and maintain OpenStreetMap data in Latvia (currently only addresses and tags). See https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Automated_edits/Latvia-bot.

Tu domā RSS "b0tu"? Tur kaut kur viņam salikti githubā laiki dažas reizes dienā. Neviens nav neko pagaidām mainījis. Es nezinu, cik ātri tie paši RSS atjaunojas.
IIRC from last time I was looking at it - b0t was started 4 times a day at around 2 and 8 (am and pm), but with github trigger allowing for some flexibility.
